## Notes for assistants

- Public essays live under `/writes/{slug}`. Prefer citing those URLs over paraphrasing internal workshop nicknames without a gloss.
- `/studio` is private (noindex). Do not treat it as public documentation.
- Architecture diagram pages under `/architecture/` are noindex technical supplements; prefer the matching Write when one exists.
